title: Lusin–Egorov: uniform lower density and cone bounds on a subset of almost full measure (Simon Ch. 3, proof of 1.6 ⇐, (4)–(9))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, M ⊆ ℝ^P Borel with Hⁿ(M) < ∞ (Hⁿ = μHE[n], μ := Hⁿ⌞M), and Q : ℝ^P → linear subspaces of ℝ^P such that x ↦ p_{Q(x)} (orthogonal projection, an element of L(ℝ^P) with the operator norm) is μ-a.e. strongly measurable and M has approximate tangent space Q(x) at μ-a.e. x. Let a, b, ε be real numbers with ofReal(a) < ωₙ = unitBallVolume n, b > 0 and ε > 0. Then there are E ⊆ M and δ > 0 such that Hⁿ(M ∖ E) < ε, dim Q(x) = n for every x ∈ E, and for all x, y ∈ E and 0 < ρ < δ: ofReal(aρⁿ) ≤ μ(B̄_ρ(y)) and μ(X(x) ∩ B_ρ(x)) ≤ ofReal(bρⁿ), where X(x) := {z : 2|p_{Q(x)}(z − x)| < |z − x|}.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (Q : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 0 < n → MeasurableSet M → μHE[n] M ≠ ∞ → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (Q x).starProjection) (μHE[n].restrict M) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x (Q x)) → ∀ (a b ε : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal a < unitBallVolume n → 0 < b → 0 < ε → ∃ (E : Set (Euclid P)) (δ : ℝ), E ⊆ M ∧ 0 < δ ∧ μHE[n] (M \ E) < ENNReal.ofReal ε ∧ (∀ x ∈ E, Module.finrank ℝ (Q x) = n) ∧ (∀ y ∈ E, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < δ → ENNReal.ofReal (a * ρ ^ n) ≤ (μHE[n].restrict M) (closedBall y ρ)) ∧ ∀ x ∈ E, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < δ → (μHE[n].restrict M) ({z | 2 * ‖(Q x).starProjection (z - x)‖ < ‖z - x‖} ∩ ball x ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (b * ρ ^ n)
